texts: bad: with the bare plural "Keepers" this is a can-claim about the whole kind, which the translator must store as a bare inability property on "keeper" — a form with no slot for "the sky-cats" and none for "exactly", so both are dropped and the claim widens to "keepers cannot count sky-cats at all". Make the subject the specific set of keepers so the clause takes the ordinary event form, which carries the counted group and the adverb: "The keepers cannot count the sky-cats exactly."
